summary: Unwrap the World Bank two-element [meta,[rows]] response envelope in the promoted data command.
reason: World Bank v2 wraps every payload as a 2-element array whose data sits at index 1; the generator's response_path cannot index array elements, so the data command otherwise returns the raw envelope.
validated_outcome: data USA NY.GDP.MKTP.CD --mrv 2 returns clean observation rows; full live dogfood 70/70.
